arXiv:2608.27296v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 8 月 27 日arXiv:2608.27296v1 [cs.AI] 27 Aug 2026

法学硕士可以设计近乎最优的 OR 算法LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

Jackie Baek ††thanks: Stern School of Business, New York University, baek@stern.nyu.edu
摘要Abstract

我们询问大型语言模型（LLM）是否可以为明确的运筹学（OR）问题设计有效的算法。 我们研究库存控制、排队网络控制和品种优化。 我们评估 LLM 使用的两个级别：在第 1 级，模型接收一个问题实例并返回该实例的解决方案；在第 1 级，模型接收一个问题实例并返回该实例的解决方案。在第 2 级，它仅接收问题类描述和广泛的参数范围，并返回将实例参数映射到解决方案的算法。 人工输入是最少的：我们给出一个未经调整的提示 描述了问题，并且模型可以访问具有固定计算预算的 Python 沙箱工具。We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.

我们测试的最强模型，The strongest model we test,gpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol，在几乎所有评估的实例上匹配或优于现有的最佳方法。 即使在级别 2 上也是如此，其中返回的算法在查看评估实例之前就已固定。 发布间隔不到八个月的模型的性能也大幅提高，这表明 这种能力正在迅速发展。 因此，对于我们研究的明确的操作问题，单个未调整的 LLM 查询已经可以产生与专门方法竞争的算法。 这些结果表明，前沿法学硕士可以成为明确的 OR 问题中算法设计的重要经验基线。, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

1 简介Introduction

运筹学 (OR) 有着针对特定运筹问题开发专门算法的悠久传统。库存控制、排队网络控制、分类优化、路线选择和收入管理各自有自己的模型、结构结果、近似方法和计算启发法。这些算法通常由研究人员设计，他们使用特定问题的知识来利用特定模型或应用程序领域的结构。Operations research (OR) has a long tradition of developing specialized algorithms for specific operational problems. Inventory control, queueing network control, assortment optimization, routing, and revenue management each have their own models, structural results, approximation methods, and computational heuristics. These algorithms are usually designed by researchers who use problem-specific knowledge to exploit the structure of a particular model or application domain.

大型语言模型 (LLM) 是一项具有广泛功能的新技术。他们可以编写代码Large language models (LLMs) are a new technology with broad capabilities. They can write code(Chen et al., 2021)，解决长期存在的开放数学问题, solve long-standing open math problems(OpenAI, 2026)，并提出跨多个领域的程序, and propose procedures across many domains(Romera-Paredes et al., 2024)。 这就提出了一个自然的问题：. This raises a natural question:

法学硕士在设计运算问题算法方面有多擅长？How good are LLMs at designing algorithms for operations problems?

回答这个问题可以帮助阐明法学硕士如何改变运筹学的工作分工。解决实际运营问题涉及许多步骤，包括制定、算法设计、实现、验证和部署。每个步骤都需要不同类型的专业知识和判断力。我们隔离算法设计步骤，并询问通用模型是否可以产生高性能算法。Answering this question can help clarify how LLMs may change the division of work in operations research. Solving a real operations problem involves many steps, including formulation, algorithm design, implementation, validation, and deployment. Each step requires different kinds of expertise and judgment. We isolate the algorithm-design step and ask whether a general-purpose model can produce high-performing algorithms.

我们通过实验来研究这个问题 在问题在数学上已明确指定但精确优化很困难的设置上。 给定问题的正式描述，我们要求法学硕士为特定实例提供解决方案，或者设计一种将实例参数映射到解决方案的算法。 我们在一种简单的单查询协议中使用 LLM：我们提供一个提示来说明问题和输出格式，而不进行任何提示调整或提供有关良好解决方案结构的提示。We study this question experimentally on settings where the problem is mathematically well specified but exact optimization is difficult. Given a formal description of the problem, we ask an LLM either to produce a solution for a particular instance or to design an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. We use the LLM in a simple one-query protocol: we provide one prompt that states the problem and the output format, without doing any prompt tuning or providing hints about the structure of a good solution.

我们研究了三个典型的 OR 领域并发表了大量文献：库存控制、排队网络控制和分类优化。对于库存，我们使用评估的实例We study three canonical OR domains with long literatures: inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. For inventory, we use the instances evaluated byGijsbrechts et al. (2022)：具有确定性和随机交货时间、双重采购和多级分销的销售损失系统。对于排队，我们使用多类排队网络实例: lost-sales systems with deterministic and stochastic lead times, dual sourcing, and multi-echelon distribution. For queueing, we use the multiclass queueing-network instances ofDai and Gluzman (2022)：纵横交错的网络、N 模型和扩展的六级可重入线网络。对于分类，我们使用以下硬基准实例: criss-cross networks, the N-model, and extended six-class reentrant-line networks. For assortment, we use the hard benchmark instances ofGuo et al. (2025)：混合 MNL、嵌套 logit 和约束混合 MNL 选择模型。这些基准总共提供了 34 个库存实例、13 个排队实例和 3,393 个分类实例。源论文的一个共同特征是，他们使用这些实例将现代深度学习或强化学习方法与经典方法进行比较。: mixed-MNL, nested-logit, and constrained mixed-MNL choice models. Together, these benchmarks give 34 inventory instances, 13 queueing instances, and 3,393 assortment instances. A common feature of the source papers is that they use these instances to compare modern deep learning or reinforcement-learning approaches with classical methods.

我们以两种方式使用法学硕士，不同之处在于它进入算法设计过程的位置：We use an LLM in two ways, differing in where it enters the algorithm-design process:

  • •

    1 级：Level 1:法学硕士被授予the LLM is given a单实例single instance及其数字参数，并返回 该实例的解决方案。with its numeric parameters, and returns a solution to that instance.

  • •

    2 级：Level 2:法学硕士被授予the LLM is given a问题类problem class和广泛的参数范围。它 返回一个将实例参数映射到解决方案的算法，然后该算法在 班级中的每个评估实例。返回的算法被要求产生每个 30 秒内针对特定实例的解决方案。and broad parameter ranges. It returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions, and that algorithm is then run on every evaluation instance in the class. The returned algorithm is asked to produce each instance-specific solution within 30 seconds.

例如，在分类优化中，1 级查询输出一个指定选择模型的一种分类，而 2 级查询输出将选择模型参数映射到分类的算法。 Level 2更接近算法设计的标准概念；我们还测试了级别 1，因为它是一个强大且自然的基准。 我们使用实例的论文中开发的方法是 1 级方法： 他们的策略针对每个实例单独进行训练For example, in assortment optimization, a level-1 query outputs one assortment for one specified choice model, whereas a level-2 query outputs an algorithm that maps choice-model parameters to an assortment. Level 2 is closer to the standard notion of algorithm design; we also test level 1 because it is a strong and natural benchmark. The methods developed in the papers whose instances we use are level-1 methods: their policies are trained separately for each instance(Gijsbrechts et al., 2022; Dai and Gluzman, 2022; Guo et al., 2025)。 对于大多数评估的实例，由于解决方案空间较大，级别 1 不能依赖于详尽的枚举。. For most evaluated instances, level 1 cannot rely on exhaustive enumeration due to the large solution space.

我们评估了跨越两个提供商且公开发布日期不到八个月的四个法学硕士：We evaluate four LLMs that span two providers and less than eight months of public release dates:GPT-5.1gpt-5.1, gpt-5.4, 和, andgpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol来自 OpenAI，以及from OpenAI, and克劳德寓言5claude-fable-5来自人类。from Anthropic.11 1公开发布日期为 2025 年 11 月 12 日 为了The public release dates are November 12, 2025 forGPT-5.1gpt-5.1，2026 年 3 月 5 日, March 5, 2026 forgpt-5.4，2026 年 6 月 9 日, June 9, 2026 for克劳德寓言5claude-fable-5（暂停访问后于 2026 年 7 月 1 日恢复），以及 2026 年 7 月 9 日(with access restored on July 1, 2026 after a temporary suspension), and July 9, 2026 forgpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol，基于提供商的公开发行说明。, based on the providers’ public release notes.所有代码、提示和完整的运行记录（每个 LLM 查询及其推理摘要、执行的代码、输出和令牌使用情况）都是公开可用的。All code, prompts, and the complete run records (every LLM query with its reasoning summaries, executed code, outputs, and token usage) are publicly available.22 2 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-or-algorithms-F9F2.

1.1 主要发现Main findings

Table 1总结了最强模型的结果，summarizes the results for the strongest model,gpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol，涵盖所有十个问题类别和两个级别。每个条目都将法学硕士与现有的最佳方法进行比较, across all ten problem classes and both levels. Each entry compares the LLM with the best existing method对于那个例子for that instance：在每个领域中，源论文报告的有关该实例的最佳方法，包括可用的确切最佳方法。: in each domain, the best of the methods reported by the source paper on that instance, including the exact optimum where available.

gpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol几乎在每个实例上都匹配或击败了现有的最佳方法。matches or beats the best existing method on nearly every instance.

横跨十个班级Across the ten classes inTable 1, gpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol在两个级别的八个类别中，其平均性能不比现有的最佳方法差。在每个级别上，都不差has mean performance no worse than the best existing method in eight classes at both levels. At each level, it is no worse on每个实例every instance分六个班。这是一个要求很高的比较：比较器是从现有方法中逐个实例选择的，包括精确的动态程序或精确的求解器（如果可用）。in six classes. This is a demanding comparison: the comparator is chosen instance by instance from the existing methods, including exact dynamic programs or exact solvers where available.

库存和排队情况均十分强劲。法学硕士在所有四个清单类别中平均改进了现有的最佳方法；在排队中，它与交叉实例上的 DP 计算的最优值相匹配，在Inventory and queueing are uniformly strong. The LLM improves on the best existing method on average in all four inventory classes; in queueing, it matches the DP-computed optimum on the criss-cross instances, is within0.2%0.2\%在 N 模型上是最优的，并且在大多数可重入线实例上击败了每个实例的 PPO 比较器。在分类中，它与所有 MMNL 实例上的最佳值和所有受约束 MMNL 实例上的最佳已知值相匹配。嵌套 logit 是主要的例外：LLM 与接近最优的 LP 策略相匹配of optimal on the N-model, and beats the per-instance PPO comparator on most reentrant-line instances. In assortment, it matches the optimum on all MMNL instances and the best known value on all constrained-MMNL instances. Nested logit is the main exception: the LLM matches the near-optimal LP policy ofKunnumkal (2023) on 87%87\%的实例，但在困难的尾巴上失败，收入平均of instances but loses on a difficult tail, with mean revenue1.2%1.2\%更低。lower.

2 级适用于结构指定的类。Level 2 works well for structurally specified classes.

2 级算法的执行效果通常与 1 级解决方案几乎一样好，尽管它们仅根据问题类描述和广泛的参数范围编写。横跨十个班级Level-2 algorithms often perform nearly as well as level-1 solutions, even though they are written from only a problem-class description and broad parameter ranges. Across the ten classes inTable 1，级别 2 的平均性能不比八个类别中现有的最佳方法差，并且在六个类别中的每个实例上都与之匹配。因此，LLM 不仅解决孤立的实例：单个未调整的查询可以为一类实例生成可重用的算法结构。, level 2 has mean performance no worse than the best existing method in eight classes and matches it on every instance in six classes. Thus, the LLM is not only solving isolated instances: a single untuned query can produce reusable algorithmic structure for a class of instances.

生成的算法具有可识别的结构。The generated algorithms have recognizable structure.

2 级算法通常使用 OR 文献中的思想。在库存中，最强的算法概括了上限基本库存策略，使用预计的 库存统计而不是原始库存状况。在类别中，最强的求解器 将小而精确的例程、基于贪婪和放松的开始以及局部改进结合起来。 在排队中，返回的策略使用熟悉的动态控制思想，包括小型状态空间上的动态编程和大型网络上基于压力的调度规则。 这使得 输出不同于黑盒学习策略（例如，基于深度强化学习的方法）或通用求解器调用：它们是可检查的 其步骤可以被解释、修改和潜在改进的算法。The level-2 algorithms often use ideas from the OR literature. In inventory, the strongest algorithm generalizes a capped base-stock policy, using a projected inventory statistic rather than the raw inventory position. In assortment, the strongest solvers combine small exact routines, greedy and relaxation-based starts, and local improvement. In queueing, the returned policies use familiar dynamic-control ideas, including dynamic programming on small state spaces and pressure-based scheduling rules on larger networks. This makes the outputs different from black-box learned policies (e.g., deep RL-based methods) or generic solver calls: they are inspectable algorithms whose steps can be explained, modified, and potentially improved.

性能随着更强大的模型而提高。Performance improves with stronger models.

我们评估的四种型号是在八个月内发布的，但它们的 性能差异很大，尤其是在级别 2 上。The four models we evaluate were released within eight months of one another, yet their performance differs substantially, especially at level 2.Figure 1给出一个 确定性销售损失库存这一模式的预览：每个点都是一个实例，显示 对于所有四个项目，LLM 政策相对于该实例上现有最佳方法的成本 两个级别的模型。 图中，gives a preview of this pattern for deterministic lost-sales inventory: each dot is one instance, showing the cost of the LLM policy relative to the best existing method on that instance, for all four models at both levels. In the figure,GPT-5.1gpt-5.1在大多数情况下，成本明显高于基准，而has significantly higher costs than the benchmark on most instances, whilegpt-5.4更接近，但仍然留下明显的差距，尤其是在 2 级。 这表明LLM 算法设计能力正在快速发展，并且 前沿法学硕士正在成为硬或问题的自然经验基线。is much closer but still leaves visible gaps, especially at level 2. This suggests that LLM algorithm-design capability is moving quickly, and that frontier LLMs are becoming a natural empirical baseline for hard OR problems.

1.2 影响和限制Implications and limitations

对 OR 研究的影响。Implications for OR research.

这些实验朝着理解法学硕士在 OR 管道中的位置迈出了一步。在我们研究的明确的基准问题中，强大的法学硕士已经可以执行部分​​算法设计步骤。 在这种情况下，算法设计变得更加便宜，这可能会将注意力转移到模型未解决的管道部分，例如制定、验证和部署。These experiments take a step toward understanding where LLMs may fit in the OR pipeline. In the well-specified benchmark problems we study, a strong LLM can already perform part of the algorithm-design step. In settings where this works, algorithm design becomes much cheaper, which may shift attention toward parts of the pipeline the model does not address, such as formulation, validation, and deployment.

这些结果并不意味着法学硕士取代了算法研究。生成的算法通常类似于已知算法结构的变体和组合。如果没有这些文献，我们就无法运行评估训练模型的反事实，因此我们不知道性能在多大程度上取决于它。在没有既定算法文献的情况下，法学硕士是否可以为问题类别设计同样强大的算法是一个悬而未决的问题。 我们的结果确实表明，在具有明确模型和丰富算法传统的领域，当前的法学硕士可以在最少的提示下产生高性能和可解释的算法。These results do not imply that LLMs replace algorithmic research. The generated algorithms often resemble variants and combinations of known algorithmic structures. We cannot run the counterfactual of evaluating a model trained without this literature, so we do not know how much of the performance depends on it. Whether LLMs can design equally strong algorithms for problem classes without an established algorithmic literature is an open question. What our results do show is that, in domains with well-specified models and rich algorithmic traditions, current LLMs can produce high-performing and interpretable algorithms from a minimal prompt.

经验证据和污染。Empirical evidence and contamination.

我们的证据是经验性的，仅限于三个 OR 设置：库存控制、排队网络控制和分类 优化。自然的下一步是在更广泛的操作上测试相同的框架 问题。我们也不能排除特定于基准的信息，例如实例、解决方案、 或性能比较，出现在模型训练中。在Our evidence is empirical and limited to three OR settings: inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. A natural next step is to test the same framework on a wider range of operations problems. We also cannot rule out that benchmark-specific information, such as instances, solutions, or performance comparisons, appeared in model training. InSection 6.2，我们部分解决 通过评估新参数值和生成实例的 2 级算法来解决这个问题 主要基准之外。 最后，我们的结果是经验性的：我们没有证明近似值 保证，并且我们不知道 LLM 生成的算法在实例之外的鲁棒性如何 我们测试的家庭。 排队实验还表明，2 级性能取决于问题类的定义方式：过于宽泛的类可能会导致模型返回在某些子类上失败的通用策略。, we partly address this concern by evaluating the level-2 algorithms on new parameter values and generated instances outside the main benchmarks. Lastly, our results are empirical: we do not prove approximation guarantees, and we do not know how robust the LLM-generated algorithms are outside the instance families we test. The queueing experiments also show that level-2 performance depends on how the problem class is defined: a class that is too broad can lead the model to return a generic policy that fails on some subclasses.

1.3 相关工作Related Work

运筹学和运营决策的法学硕士。LLMs for operations research and operational decision-making.

越来越多的文献研究法学硕士在运营决策方面的作用。 我们按照法学硕士进入决策流程的位置来组织这些工作：制定、提供模型输入、设计解决方案和做出决策。 我们的工作与第三阶段相关，涉及到第四阶段。 该地区的调查跨越这些阶段并强调可靠性， 建模错误和工具使用A growing literature studies LLMs in operational decision-making. We organize these works by where the LLM enters the decision pipeline: formulation, supplying model inputs, designing the solution, and making the decision. Our work is related to the third stage and touches the fourth. Surveys of the area span these stages and emphasize reliability, modeling errors, and tool use(Wang and Li, 2025; Simchi-Levi et al., 2026).

1. 制定模型。1. Formulating the model.

一个流将公式视为翻译问题：给定 自然语言问题陈述，法学硕士生成优化模型、求解器代码，或 模型文件One stream treats formulation as a translation problem: given natural-language problem statements, LLMs produce optimization models, solver code, or model files(Ramamonjison et al., 2023; AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2025)。 其他工作为同一制定任务建立基准、训练数据和搜索程序. Other work builds benchmarks, training data, and search procedures for the same formulation task(Astorga et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025; Jiang et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024)。 第二组研究更混乱、更现实的环境，其中模型是交互式构建、修复或指定的，而不是从干净的问题陈述翻译过来的. A second group studies messier, more realistic settings in which the model is built, repaired, or specified interactively rather than translated from a clean problem statement(Xiao et al., 2024; Li et al., 2023; Ao et al., 2026; Drossman et al., 2026; Lawless et al., 2024; Liang et al., 2026).

2. 构建模型输入。2. Constructing model inputs.

第二个流使用 LLM 来构造或导出原语 选择模型类别后需要优化模型。A second stream uses LLMs to construct or elicit the primitives an optimization model needs after the model class has been chosen.Baek et al. (2026a)使用 LLM 生成的角色来构建样本平均近似值的分布，use LLM-generated personas to build distributions for sample-average approximation,Huang and Wang (2026)使用法学硕士支持的虚拟人群进行需求模拟和定价， 和use LLM-powered virtual populations for demand simulation and pricing, andDuan et al. (2025)研究人类-法学硕士对库存控制投入的澄清。study human–LLM clarification of inventory-control inputs.

我们的实验故意删除了前两个阶段。优化问题已经 以精确的数学术语指定，因此我们不测试公式。每个参数都是已知的 准确并在提示中说明，因此我们不测试数据生成。Our experiment deliberately removes these first two stages. The optimization problem is already specified in precise mathematical terms, so we do not test formulation. Every parameter is known exactly and stated in the prompt, so we do not test data generation.

3.设计解决方法。3. Designing the solution method.

第三个流派使用法学硕士来设计解决方案方法，而不是制定模型、提供输入或做出单一决策。我们的论文属于这个流：在第 2 层，模型返回一个可重用的算法，将未来的实例参数映射到决策。A third stream uses LLMs to design solution methods rather than to formulate models, supply inputs, or make a single decision. Our paper belongs in this stream: at level 2, the model returns a reusable algorithm that maps future instance parameters to decisions.Zhang et al. (2026)使用LLM生成随机优化中追索决策规则的基函数；相对于这项工作，我们将算法结构的选择留给模型，而不是丰富固定的决策规则类。use an LLM to generate basis functions for recourse decision rules in stochastic optimization; relative to that work, we leave the choice of algorithmic structure to the model rather than enriching a fixed decision-rule class.

其他工作将法学硕士嵌入迭代算法发现循环中。在库存中，Other work embeds the LLM in an iterative algorithm-discovery loop. In inventory,Huang et al. (2026)使用进化搜索进行白盒策略，相关系统重复生成、评估和修改代码或启发式想法use evolutionary search for white-box policies, and related systems repeatedly generate, evaluate, and revise code or heuristic ideas(Romera-Paredes et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024; Ye et al., 2024; van Stein and Bäck, 2025; Zheng et al., 2025; Google DeepMind, 2025; Yang et al., 2024);看到; seeLiu et al. (2026)进行调查。 我们的目标与这些作品不同；我们不会尝试围绕法学硕士优化支架。相反，我们询问前沿法学硕士在简单的单查询协议下的表现如何：跨问题类使用相同的提示结构、沙箱和计算预算。for a survey. Our goal is different from these works; we do not try to optimize the scaffold around the LLM. Instead, we ask how well a frontier LLM performs under a simple single-query protocol: the same prompt structure, sandbox, and compute budget are used across problem classes.

相关线路在通用 MILP 求解器中使用 LLM。A related line uses LLMs inside generic MILP solvers.Lawless et al. (2025)根据问题描述和求解器文档配置切割平面分隔符，而其他 工作使用LLM引导的搜索来生成剪切、大邻域搜索规则或分支 政策configure cutting-plane separators from a problem description and solver documentation, while other work uses LLM-guided search to generate cuts, large-neighborhood-search rules, or branching policies(Yazdani et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2025; Hou et al., 2026)。这些论文利用法学硕士来 在已建立的解算器管道中选择或生成组件，例如分支和切割或 大范围搜索。. These papers use LLMs to choose or generate components inside established solver pipelines, such as branch-and-cut or large-neighborhood search.

4、直接决策。4. Direct decision-making.

第四个流将法学硕士直接置于决策席上，并衡量其在库存、零售、经济、定价和供应链环境中的行动A fourth stream places the LLM directly in the decision seat and measures its actions in inventory, retail, economic, pricing, and supply-chain environments(Baek et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2025; Zhao et al., 2025; Tanlamai et al., 2026; Cohen and Hage-Youssef, 2026; Ahmed et al., 2026; Long et al., 2025)。相关工作研究了强盗和经济环境中的法学硕士探索，模型必须通过交互来学习其规范. Related work studies LLM exploration in bandit and economic environments whose specification the model must learn through interaction(Krishnamurthy et al., 2024; Fish et al., 2025)。我们的 1 级实验是相关的，尤其是在分类中，模型返回一个决策而不是可重用的过程。 关键的区别在于，在现有的大部分工作中，法学硕士仍然有关于表述的主观判断的空间：追求什么目标以及哪些约束很重要。在我们的设置中，我们为法学硕士提供完整的数学规范和所有参数，并仅根据现有算法测试最终决策的质量。. Our level-1 experiments are related, especially in assortment, where the model returns a decision rather than a reusable procedure. The key difference is that, in much of the existing work, the LLM still has room for subjective judgment about formulation: what objective to pursue and which constraints matter. In our setting, we give the LLM the full mathematical specification and all parameters, and test only the quality of the resulting decision against existing algorithms.

OR 算法设计的通用方法。General methods for OR algorithm design.

在法学硕士之前，针对特定问题的算法设计的主要通用替代方案是机器学习和强化学习。该文献提出了库存控制的学习策略和价值函数近似值Before LLMs, the main general-purpose alternative to problem-specific algorithm design was machine learning and reinforcement learning. This literature has produced learned policies and value-function approximations for inventory control(Van Roy et al., 1997; Gijsbrechts et al., 2022; Temizöz et al., 2025; Xie et al., 2026; Alvo et al., 2023; Harsha et al., 2025)、排队控制, queueing control(Moallemi et al., 2008; Shah et al., 2020; Qu et al., 2020; Liu et al., 2022; Wei et al., 2023; Dai and Gluzman, 2022; Chen et al., 2024)，以及品种优化和路由, and assortment optimization and routing(Wang et al., 2023; Aouad and Désir, 2025; Li et al., 2026; Bello et al., 2017; Kool et al., 2019).

这些方法提出了一个与我们接近的问题：需要多少特定问题的输入才能获得有竞争力的算法？现有的 ML/RL 方法通常需要模拟器、策略类和大量调整，并且它们通常会生成黑盒策略或值函数。我们的 2 级工件是用代码编写的可执行算法，因此可以检查、诊断和修改它们的逻辑。These methods ask a question close to ours: how much problem-specific input is needed to obtain a competitive algorithm? Existing ML/RL approaches typically require a simulator, a policy class, and substantial tuning, and they usually produce black-box policies or value functions. Our level-2 artifacts are executable algorithms written in code, so their logic can be inspected, diagnosed, and modified.

基准和基线。Benchmarks and baselines.

我们的实验使用已发布的库存控制、排队网络基准系列 调度和品种优化。 在此之前，最近呼吁在随机 OR 中进行更系统的经验基准测试：Our experiments use published benchmark families in inventory control, queueing-network scheduling, and assortment optimization. This follows recent calls for more systematic empirical benchmarking in stochastic OR:Dong et al. (2026)主张评估结构化实例系列的算法，使用 可重复使用的模拟器、共享基线和明确的协议，而不是孤立的数字 例子。 LLM 驱动的算法设计的最新基准，例如 CO-Benchargue for evaluating algorithms on structured instance families, using reusable simulators, shared baselines, and explicit protocols rather than isolated numerical examples. Recent benchmarks for LLM-driven algorithm design, such as CO-Bench(Sun et al., 2026)和HeuriGymand HeuriGym(Chen et al., 2026)，还要求LLM代理编写可重用的算法。, also ask LLM agents to write reusable algorithms.

库存基准涵盖快速精确动态规划的问题类别 棘手的。在销售损失库存中，最优策略取决于未偿还库存的完整向量 订单，因此状态空间在前置时间内呈指数增长，并且精确的动态规划已经过时 超越较短的交货时间The inventory benchmark covers problem classes where exact dynamic programming is quickly intractable. In lost-sales inventory, the optimal policy depends on the full vector of outstanding orders, so the state space grows exponentially in the lead time and exact dynamic programming is out of reach beyond short lead times(Zipkin, 2008b; Zipkin, 2008a)。这导致了 专门的政策系列，包括近视、基本股票、恒定顺序和上限基本股票 政策. This has led to specialized policy families, including myopic, base-stock, constant-order, and capped base-stock policies(Huh et al., 2009; Goldberg et al., 2016; Xin, 2021; Xin, 2026)，这是库存 我们评估的基准。双源具有类似的管道状态依赖性, which are the inventory benchmarks we evaluate against. Dual sourcing has a similar pipeline-state dependence(Veeraraghavan and Scheller-Wolf, 2008)，并且对于多级分布没有已知的易于处理的最优策略； 这些困难激发了深度强化学习基准, and no tractable optimal policy is known for multi-echelon distribution; these difficulties motivate the deep reinforcement-learning benchmark ofGijsbrechts et al. (2022).

排队基准涵盖多类网络，其中调度决策确定哪些兼容队列在每次到达或服务完成后接收服务。精确的动态规划对于小型纵横交错和 N 模型实例是可用的，但对于较大的可重入线网络来说变得不可行，因为状态是队列长度的完整向量。这激发了与结构化调度规则和每个实例训练的强化学习策略的比较The queueing benchmark covers multiclass networks in which scheduling decisions determine which compatible queues receive service after each arrival or service completion. Exact dynamic programming is available for the small criss-cross and N-model instances, but becomes infeasible for the larger reentrant-line networks because the state is the full vector of queue lengths. This motivates comparisons with structured scheduling rules and per-instance-trained reinforcement learning policies inDai and Gluzman (2022)。相同的可重入线实例也出现在 QGym 中. The same reentrant-line instances also appear in QGym(Chen et al., 2024);在; inSection C.3，我们报告了针对 QGym 报告的 RL 控制器的有限范围交叉检查。, we report a finite-horizon cross-check against QGym’s reported RL controllers.

在可处理性很大程度上取决于产品的环境中，分类基准发挥着相同的作用。 选择模型。多项logit模型结构坚固The assortment benchmark plays the same role in a setting where tractability depends sharply on the choice model. The multinomial logit model has strong structure(Talluri and van Ryzin, 2004)，但是 即使没有约束，混合多项 Logit 模型下的分类优化也是 NP 困难的, but assortment optimization under the mixed multinomial logit model is NP-hard even without constraints(Bront et al., 2009; Rusmevichientong et al., 2014)，并且一般线性约束添加了另一个来源 困难。对于嵌套 logit，当嵌套指数 参数最多为1个, and general linear constraints add another source of difficulty. For nested logit, the problem is polynomially solvable when the nest exponent parameters are at most one(Davis et al., 2014; Gallego and Topaloglu, 2014)，但是一旦他们 超过一, but NP-hard once they exceed one(Davis et al., 2014; Kunnumkal, 2023)。我们使用的基准实例有 嵌套指数参数. The benchmark instances we use have nest exponent parameters in[2,3][2,3]和每嵌套基数约束，将它们置于困难中 政权。我们使用硬实例基准and per-nest cardinality constraints, placing them in the hard regime. We use the hard-instance benchmark ofGuo et al. (2025)，其目的是 强调标准分类启发法。, which was designed to stress standard assortment heuristics.

We use this flexibility in the queueing experiments by trying two definitions of level 2: a primary definition with fixed queueing-network structures, and a broader problem class definition that allows arbitrary multiclass networks up to the same size range.

资源限制。Resource constraints.

如果没有进一步的限制，各个级别可能会相互折叠。 2 级算法 可能只是Without further restrictions, the levels can collapse into one another. A level-2 algorithm could simply beσ⁡(θ)=LLM⁡(θ)\sigma(\theta)=\mathrm{LLM}(\theta)。 因此，我们对查询和返回的可执行对象都设置了资源约束，并且我们 完全禁止从返回代码调用 LLM。 人们可以定义允许 LLM 访问或 LLM 访问和代码执行的组合的预算， 但我们在本文中不研究这些变体。. We therefore put resource constraints on both the query and the returned executable object, and we disallow LLM calls from returned code entirely. One could define budgets that permit LLM access, or a combination of LLM access and code execution, but we do not study those variants in this paper.

请注意，较低级别严格具有更多信息：在级别 1 查询的模型会看到实例本身，而级别 2 算法只能在其上执行其编写的代码。 然而，级别 1 的这种信息优势并不一定转化为更好的经验绩效； 我们的实验比较了各个级别的性能。Note that a lower level has strictly more information: a model queried at level 1 sees the instance itself, while a level-2 algorithm can only execute its written code on it. However, this informational advantage of level 1 does not necessarily translate into better empirical performance; our experiments compare performance across the levels.

3.2 LLM实验和基准政策LLM experiments and benchmark policies

我们查询 1 级和 2 级的 LLM 模型。 1 级每个实例使用一个查询； 2级 每个问题类使用一个查询，确定性和随机的交付时间被视为单独的 类。 每个查询的沙箱预算为 3600 秒的 Python 计算，最多 50 个 来电。返回的代码在 LLM 会话之外进行评估：1 级代码可以进行一次性设置 在模块导入时，二级代码定义了We query LLM models at both level 1 and level 2. Level 1 uses one query per instance; level 2 uses one query per problem class, with deterministic and stochastic lead times treated as separate classes. Each query has a sandbox budget of 3600 seconds of Python compute across at most 50 calls. The returned code is evaluated outside the LLM session: level-1 code may do one-time setup at module import, and level-2 code defines a设计design routine that maps instance parameters to an ordering policy. In both cases, the prompt asks this setup or design step to finish within 30 seconds per instance, and asks the per-period order function to be lightweight. Additional details are reported in Appendix A; prompt examples are reported in Appendix H.

Benchmark policies.

No simple policy is optimal in any of these settings, so the literature has produced structured heuristics, several of them carrying performance guarantees. We write II for on-hand inventory at the moment of ordering and QQ for the total quantity on order but not yet arrived, so the inventory position is I+QI+Q, and (z)+=max⁡{z,0}(z)^{+}=\max\{z,0\}. The quantities shown in parentheses are the policy’s free parameters; for each benchmark policy, the free parameters are tuned separately for each instance by grid search.

  • •

    Base-stock (S)(S): order (S−I−Q)+(S-I-Q)^{+}. Optimal when unmet demand is backordered, but suboptimal under lost sales.

  • •

    Constant-order (r)(r): order rr every period, whatever the state. Introduced by Reiman (2004) and asymptotically optimal as the lead time grows (Goldberg et al., 2016), since a long pipeline leaves the current state progressively less informative about what will be needed when an order finally arrives.

  • •

    Capped base-stock (S,b)(S,b): order min⁡{b,(S−I−Q)+}\min\{\,b,\ (S-I-Q)^{+}\}; this policy class has a 2.332.33-approximation guarantee (Xin, 2021; Xin, 2026).

  • •

    Mixed strategy (r,P)(r,P): order rr with probability PP and r+1r+1 otherwise. Introduced by Gijsbrechts et al. (2022), after observing their trained A3C policy alternate between two order sizes, because order quantities are integers while the best constant rate generally is not.

  • •

    Myopic (no free parameters): order to minimize expected cost over the next one or two periods.

Simulator validation and scoring details are in Appendices A and B.

3.3 Results

We summarize the main lost-sales results here; the full results are reported in Section B.4.

Overall performance.

Figures 1 and 4 give the main lost-sales result, split by deterministic and stochastic lead times. Each dot is measured against the best existing method on that instance. Across all 26 lost-sales instances, gpt-5.6-sol beats the best tuned benchmark on 23 instances at level 1 and is within 0.5%0.5\% on all 26. At level 2, the model writes only two algorithms, one for deterministic lead times and one for stochastic lead times. Those algorithms beat the best tuned benchmark on 21 instances and are again within 0.5%0.5\% on all 26.

claude-fable-5 shows that the strong performance is not unique to one provider, but it is less reliable than gpt-5.6-sol. Across the 26 lost-sales instances, it is within 0.5%0.5\% of the best tuned benchmark on 25 instances at level 1 and 23 at level 2. The weaker OpenAI models show a clear capability gradient. gpt-5.4 is competitive at level 1 but never beats the tuned benchmark at level 2, while gpt-5.1 is worse at both levels. Since the four models were released within less than eight months, these gaps suggest rapid progress.

For deterministic lead times, the level-2 algorithm comes from one class-level query: 598 seconds of wall time, including 54.9 seconds of sandbox compute. After the query, the returned algorithm’s design time is 3.0 seconds per instance on average, with a maximum of 4.8 seconds. By comparison, level 1 uses one query per deterministic instance; across the same instances, the mean query wall time is 2,248 seconds, including 1,959 seconds of sandbox compute, and the mean module-load time is 1.8 seconds. Full inventory timing results are in Tables 13 and 14.

We now examine selected instance groups more closely to understand where these aggregate results come from.

The weaker models are less consistent, especially at level 2. Thus, when exact optimization is within reach, the strongest models are able to compute it.

(2022)，A3C大多匹配强启发式而不是明显改进 在他们身上。 在短交付周期的电网上，A3C 没有找到最佳方案，其表现优于上限基础油。 在确定性提前期扫描中，A3C 最初优于标准基准，但这一观察结果激励 混合策略，然后与 A3C 性能相匹配。 相比之下，, A3C mostly matches strong heuristics rather than clearly improving on them. 在我们的分类中，A3C 是一种 1 级方法： 训练和超参数调整是针对每个实例单独完成的，从而产生一个策略 该实例而不是跨实例传输的算法。这条管道很昂贵： 该论文报告称，一项超参数设置需要大约 24 个 CPU 小时来评估，并且 自动调整过程评估大约 250 个超参数设置。我们的二级算法来了 来自最多一小时沙箱计算的一个查询，加上报告的灯光设置计算 在In our taxonomy, A3C is a level-1 approach: the training and hyperparameter tuning are done separately for each instance, producing a policy for that instance rather than an algorithm that transfers across instances. This pipeline is expensive: the paper reports that one hyperparameter setting takes about 24 CPU-hours to evaluate, and that the automatic tuning procedure evaluates approximately 250 hyperparameter settings. Our level-2 algorithms come from one query with at most one hour of sandbox compute, plus the light setup computation reported inSection 6.1。返回的对象也不同。 A3C 生产黑匣子 政策，而二级 LLM 算法是可检查和可解释的代码。. The returned object is also different. A3C produces a black-box policy, whereas the level-2 LLM algorithm is inspectable and interpretable code.

3.4 确定性交付周期的 LLM 算法结构Structure of LLM algorithms for deterministic lead times

我们检查提交的代码以了解模型正在做什么，重点关注 确定性销售损失实例。 1 级返回的策略是特定于实例的，并且 异构：在短交付周期的网格上，更强的模型通常会构建显式的 动态编程表或压缩查找策略，而在较大的实例上，它们会切换到 调整启发式。 2 级算法信息更丰富，因为每个算法都必须定义一个 适用于整个实例系列的可重用策略构建规则。We inspect the submitted code to understand what the models are doing, focusing on the deterministic lost-sales instances. The level-1 returned policies are instance-specific and heterogeneous: on the short-lead-time grid, the stronger models often build explicit dynamic-programming tables or compressed lookup policies, while on larger instances they switch to tuned heuristics. The level-2 algorithms are more informative, because each one must define a reusable policy-construction rule for a whole family of instances.Appendix G总结了这些算法背后选定的推理记录。在各个类别中，该模型遵循相同的广泛顺序：回顾已知结构、权衡启发式的精确方法、预算计算、构建测试台以及防范边缘情况。summarizes selected reasoning transcripts behind these algorithms. Across classes, the model follows the same broad sequence: recalling known structure, weighing exact methods against heuristics, budgeting compute, building a testbed, and guarding against edge cases.

确定的交付周期。Deterministic lead times.

确定性 2 级算法The deterministic level-2 algorithm fromgpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol是预计库存政策。它概括了上限基础油的想法：它保留了 按订单/上限订单结构，但用预计的、风险调整后的库存统计数据取代原始库存头寸。 该算法近似于提前期窗口后可用库存的分布，并通过其均值和方差进行总结。它通过销售损失动态递归地传播当前状态来计算这些矩，第一步使用精确的泊松矩，后续步骤使用正态近似。 然后它命令is a projected inventory policy. It generalizes the capped base-stock idea: it keeps the order-up-to/capped-order structure, but replaces raw inventory position with a projected, risk-adjusted inventory statistic. The algorithm approximates the distribution of usable inventory after the lead-time window, summarized by its mean and variance. It computes these moments by recursively propagating the current state through the lost-sales dynamics, using exact Poisson moments for the first step and a normal approximation for later steps. It then orders

q=min⁡{q¯,(T−m−γ​v)+},q=\min\{\bar{q},\,\left(T-m-\gamma\sqrt{v}\right)^{+}\},

四舍五入为整数，其中rounded to an integer, whereq¯\bar{q}是每个周期的订单上限，is the per-period order cap andγ\gamma可能是 负数，在这种情况下，方差项会增加安全库存。 参数may be negative, in which case the variance term adds safety stock. The parametersTT和andγ\gamma被选择在里面are chosen inside设计design通过模拟：代码在相同的模拟需求路径上评估候选值，首先在粗网格上，然后在最佳区域周围的细化网格上。 该代码还明确处理边缘情况：当有效销售损失惩罚为非正数时，它从不订购；当持有空闲并且需求超过订单上限时，它会按容量订购。by simulation: the code evaluates candidate values on the same simulated demand paths, first over a coarse grid and then over a refined grid around the best region. The code also handles edge cases explicitly: it never orders when the effective lost-sales penalty is nonpositive, and it orders at capacity when holding is free and demand exceeds the order cap.

较弱的模型。Weaker models.

But it remains essentially a one-parameter target policy, without the mean-variance correction and broader simulation search used bygpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol。它匹配调整后的基准 交货时间短，但落后约. 主要的定性教训是，前沿模型不仅调整已知的基础油 阈值。它找到了销售损失的更好状态表示：现有库存以及 很快到达的订单比迟到的订单更有价值，政策应该响应 预期可用库存及其周围的不确定性。The main qualitative lesson is that the frontier model is not only tuning a known base-stock threshold. It finds a better state representation for lost sales: inventory already on hand and orders arriving soon are more valuable than orders arriving late, and the policy should respond to both the expected usable inventory and the uncertainty around it.

This is much broader than the structural classes used for the main L2 queueing results. The Broad L2 query returns a generic index-plus-pressure rule. It is competitive on the extended six-class networks, but performs poorly on the criss-cross and N-model instances, where good policies require topology-specific threshold behavior. These results show that the definition of the problem class matters: a structurally specified class lets the model choose an appropriate strategy, while a too-broad class can elicit a reasonable-looking generic rule with classical failure modes.

4.4 结构Structure of thegpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol政策policies

我们检查返回的工件We inspect the artifacts returned bygpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol。在第 1 级，模型使用动态规划或 在小型网络上近似动态规划，然后返回阈值或查找表 政策。在较大的六类网络上，它搜索对队列进行评分的压力类型规则 使用其自身的长度和下游拥塞，并通过模拟调整参数。. At level 1, the model uses dynamic programming or approximate dynamic programming on the small networks and then returns threshold or lookup-table policies. On the larger six-class networks, it searches over pressure-type rules that score a queue using its own length and downstream congestion, with parameters tuned by simulation.

对于二级交叉 类，返回的For the level-2 criss-cross class, the returned设计design例程求解截断平均成本动态规划 三个队列长度。生成的策略具有阈值形式：一台服务器为中间队列提供服务 当它非空时，而另一个则在填充中间队列和服务于中间队列之间进行选择 外部队列按照状态切换曲线。routine solves a truncated average-cost dynamic program on the three queue lengths. The resulting policy has a threshold form: one server serves the middle queue when it is nonempty, while the other chooses between feeding that middle queue and serving the outside queue according to a switching curve in the state.

N 模型工件在二维状态上使用相同的想法。它计算一个值函数 表并提取灵活服务器的切换边界：当两个队列都非空时， 策略决定灵活服务器是否应该帮助高成本类别或服务其他类别 基于两个队列长度和持有成本。The N-model artifact uses the same idea on the two-dimensional state. It computes a value-function table and extracts a switching boundary for the flexible server: when both queues are nonempty, the policy decides whether the flexible server should help the high-cost class or serve the other class based on the two queue lengths and holding costs.

对于可重入线类，精确的动态规划太大。改为 level-2 算法 构建了一系列压力规则。该规则为积压量大且高的队列提供高优先级 持有成本，但它也解释了下游拥塞：为上游队列提供服务较少 当它将工作发送到拥挤的下游队列时很有价值。分数按服务衡量 速率和静态路由位置项，因此可以对瓶颈和后期队列进行加权 与早期队列不同。的For the reentrant-line class, exact dynamic programming is too large. The level-2 algorithm instead constructs a family of pressure rules. The rule gives high priority to queues with large backlogs and high holding costs, but it also accounts for downstream congestion: serving an upstream queue is less valuable when it would send work into a congested downstream queue. The score is scaled by service rates and by a static route-position term, so bottleneck and late-stage queues can be weighted differently from early-stage queues. The设计design然后例程模拟一个小菜单 这些压力规则，为实例选择最佳参数设置，并返回一个轻量级 只需重新计算队列分数的事件级策略。routine then simulates a small menu of these pressure rules, chooses the best parameter setting for the instance, and returns a lightweight event-level policy that only has to recompute the queue scores.

5.4 两种类型的MMNL结构The two-type MMNL structure

阅读 MMNL 结果时应注意一个重要的警告。全部The MMNL results should be read with an important caveat. All628628已发布的 MMNL 实例有 只有两个不同的产品效用向量。因此，如果认识到这种结构，就很容易 找到确切的最佳分类：按价格对每个实用程序类别进行排序，并枚举有多少个 从每个班级拿走的产品。我们的独立求解器使用此枚举并确认 所有的基准优化released MMNL instances have only two distinct product-utility vectors. Thus, if this structure is recognized, it is easy to find the exact optimal assortment: sort each utility class by price, and enumerate how many products to take from each class. Our independent solver uses this enumeration and confirms the benchmark optima on all628628实例。instances.

有趣的是，2 级算法解决了这个基准测试，因为提示没有给出 示例实例并没有提及两种类型的结构。在已发表的启发式和 学习基线，没有任何方法能够充分利用这种崩溃来匹配每个的最佳值 实例； LLM 求解器可以。与此同时，结果并不像最初出现的那样强烈： 该算法没有完全通用地求解一般 MMNL；他们正在解决一个高度 结构化的两类基准。It is still interesting that level-2 algorithms solve this benchmark, because the prompt gives no example instances and does not mention the two-type structure. Among the published heuristic and learning baselines, no method exploits this collapse well enough to match the optimum on every instance; the LLM solvers do. At the same time, the result is less strong than it first appears: the algorithms are not solving general MMNL in full generality; they are solving a highly structured two-type benchmark.

5.5 LLM算法的结构Structure of the LLM algorithms

我们检查选定的We inspect the selectedgpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol2 级算法来了解它们在做什么。在分类优化中，返回的对象不是库存中的策略，而是求解器：将新实例映射到一个分类的可执行代码。我们仅描述选定的level-2 algorithms to understand what they are doing. In assortment optimization the returned object is not a policy, as in inventory, but a solver: executable code that maps a new instance to one assortment. We describe only the selectedgpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol这里是求解器；solvers here;Appendix G给出了模型推理的更多细节。gives more detail on the model’s reasoning.

具有基数约束的 MMNL。MMNL with cardinality constraint.

的Thegpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol MMNL solver is a heuristic portfolio with exact branches for easy cases. It solves one-segment and small-enumeration cases directly; otherwise it generates candidate assortments from score-ordered prefixes, greedy add and delete paths, randomized starts, and a continuous relaxation. It then polishes the best candidates with add, drop, and swap local search. Thus the solver is stronger than a single revenue-ordered or greedy rule, but it is not a general exact MMNL algorithm; its exactness on the released benchmark should be read together with the two-type structure in Section 5.4.

Nested logit.

The gpt-5.6-sol nested-logit solver uses the separable structure of the model. It summarizes each nest-level subset by its numerator and attraction contribution, builds a pool of candidate subsets for each nest, and then chooses one subset per nest using a fractional-programming update. For a current revenue target, the cross-nest step scores each candidate by “numerator minus target times attraction,” then updates the target from the resulting full assortment. This uses ideas from nested-logit assortment algorithms and bounds (Davis et al., 2014; Kunnumkal, 2023), but with a richer generated menu than price-ordered prefixes alone.

MMNL with general linear constraints.

The gpt-5.6-sol constrained-MMNL solver is a resource-aware portfolio. It filters individually infeasible products, repairs candidates to satisfy the linear constraints, generates greedy and relaxation-based starts, and improves feasible candidates by add, drop, and swap moves. When time permits, it also solves continuous relaxations and restricted MILP subproblems around the incumbent. The code therefore combines standard OR primitives: relax, round, repair, locally improve, and occasionally solve a small exact subproblem.

6 Robustness and Sensitivity Checks

The main results use a fixed compute budget and a single LLM query per result. This section checks whether the results are sensitive to query-time compute (Section 6.1), whether they extend to new instances (Section 6.2), and how much they vary across repeated runs of the same LLM query (Section 6.3).

6.1 The role of query-time tools

We remove sandbox compute entirely and measure how much the results change. We rerun selected gpt-5.6-sol queries with the compute budget set to zero. The prompt is unchanged except that it states a budget of 0 seconds, so the model cannot execute Python to run simulations or test a policy; it must write its answer from reasoning alone.

The main result is a contrast between levels. At level 2, zero query-time compute works surprisingly well for inventory and assortment: the model can write strong reusable algorithms without running simulations or testing candidates during the query. For queueing, level-2 zero-compute remains strong on the criss-cross class, but performs worse on the N-model and extended reentrant-line classes. At level 1, the same removal is much more damaging in the inventory experiment, where most zero-compute policies fall back to simple closed-form heuristics and perform worse than the tuned benchmark.

Inventory.

Table 7 reruns the deterministic lost-sales lead-time sweep with zero query-time compute. At level 2, the zero-compute algorithm beats the best tuned benchmark on all six lead-time instances and is within 0.40.4 percentage points of the full-budget algorithm on every one of them. At level 1, removing the Python tool hurts much more: five of the six zero-compute policies are simple closed-form heuristics and trail the benchmark by 3.5%3.5\% to 13%13\%.

Assortment.

We also rerun the level-2 assortment queries with zero query-time compute. Table 8 reports the results using the same comparator as Figure 6: mean revenue as a percentage of the best existing method on each instance, and the share of instances on which the algorithm is no worse than it. For all three assortment families, removing sandbox compute leaves mean performance unchanged at the precision we report.

Queueing.

The queueing zero-compute results are more mixed. Table 9 reports the corresponding class-average cost gaps. For the criss-cross class, the zero-compute artifact is essentially optimal because its returned design routine can solve the small dynamic program at evaluation time. The N-model artifact is about 7%7\%高于最佳值，比较 与约above optimum, compared with about0.2%0.2\%与计算。在扩展的可重入线实例上，计算量仍然为零 可用但大约with compute. On the extended reentrant-line instances, zero compute remains usable but is about2.4%2.4\%平均高于 PPO 比较器，而全预算 2 级 算法比 PPO 快约above the PPO comparator on average, while the full-budget level-2 algorithm beats PPO by about5.0%5.0\%。这表明零查询时间计算可以在以下情况下工作： 返回的代码仍然可以稍后进行相关优化，但是查询时模拟有助于 更大或更不精确的排队类别。. This suggests that zero query-time compute can work when the returned code can still do the relevant optimization later, but query-time simulation helps on the larger or less exact queueing classes.

6.2 泛化到新实例Generalization to new instances

对于库存和分类，我们询问 2 级算法是否可以推广到超出 主要实验中使用的评估网格。此检查有助于解决基准污染问题： 如果主要结果仅反映公共基准网格的记忆，则相同的冻结代码 就没有那么多理由去处理这些新实例。我们使用主要的二级算法 在新实例上运行并评估相同的返回代码；不再查询任何模型。For inventory and assortment, we ask whether the level-2 algorithms generalize beyond the evaluation grids used in the main experiments. Since the runtime target is stated but not enforced, the draws that treated it as a hard constraint gave up accuracy they did not need to give up: the failure is a judgment call about a soft constraint, not an inability to design the right algorithm.

总体而言，稳定性研究表明主要结果并不是由一次抽奖驱动的。主要的失败模式不是有效算法之间的巨大性能差异，而是偶尔出现的有缺陷或不可评估的工件：在评估协议下，97 次重复抽奖中有 5 次失败，其中 3 次是分类失败，2 次是排队失败。Overall, the stability study suggests that the main results are not driven by a single lucky draw. The main failure mode is not large performance variation among valid algorithms, but occasional defective or non-evaluable artifacts: five of 97 repeated draws fail under the evaluation protocol, three in assortment and two in queueing.

7 结论Conclusion

本文询问通用法学硕士是否可以为困难的、明确的操作问题设计算法。在库存控制、排队网络控制和分类优化基准方面，最强的模型在几乎所有评估的实例上都匹配或优于现有的最佳方法。 2 级结果尤其重要：模型不仅仅是搜索一种解决方案，而是生成跨多个实例传输的算法过程。This paper asks whether a general-purpose LLM can design algorithms for hard, well-specified operations problems. Across inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization benchmarks, the strongest model matches or outperforms the best existing method on nearly all evaluated instances. The level-2 result is especially important: the model is not merely searching for one solution, but producing algorithmic procedures that transfer across many instances.

生成的算法并不是神秘的黑匣子。它们通常类似于熟悉的 OR 思想的变体和组合，包括上限基础库存政策、小状态动态计划、基于压力的调度规则和本地搜索。这是一个警告，但也是使结果有意义的一部分。我们不知道性能在多大程度上取决于对现有 OR 文献的了解，但结果表明，一旦问题类别拥有丰富的算法知识，前沿法学硕士可能能够重新组合这些知识，并以低成本将其转变为强大的工作求解器。The generated algorithms are not mysterious black boxes. They often resemble variants and combinations of familiar OR ideas, including capped base-stock policies, small-state dynamic programs, pressure-based scheduling rules, and local search. This is a caveat, but also part of what makes the result meaningful. We do not know how much performance depends on exposure to the existing OR literature, but the results suggest that once a problem class has a rich body of algorithmic knowledge, a frontier LLM may be able to recombine that knowledge and turn it into a strong working solver at low cost.

实际的运营问题仍然需要对目标和权衡进行制定、测量、验证、部署和判断。本文仅隔离算法设计步骤。在我们研究的明确的基准问题中，该步骤似乎已经部分自动化：强大的法学硕士可以将数学描述转化为高性能、可解释的代码。了解何时成功、何时失败以及如何验证生成的算法是未来工作的重要方向。Real operations problems still require formulation, measurement, validation, deployment, and judgment about objectives and trade-offs. This paper isolates only the algorithm-design step. In the well-specified benchmark problems we study, that step already appears partly automatable: a strong LLM can turn a mathematical description into high-performing, interpretable code. Understanding when this succeeds, when it fails, and how to validate the resulting algorithms is an important direction for future work.

附录AAppendix A协议详情Protocol details

模型。Models.

我们使用四种模型：We use four models:gpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.4, 和, andGPT-5.1gpt-5.1来自 开放人工智能，以及from OpenAI, and克劳德寓言5claude-fable-5来自人类。送达日期戳 我们日志中的标识符是from Anthropic. The date-stamped served identifiers in our logs aregpt-5.1-2025-11-13和andgpt-5.4-2026-03-05。记录的标识符为. The logged identifiers forgpt-5.6-溶胶gpt-5.6-sol和and克劳德寓言5claude-fable-5不包含日期后缀，因此我们通过别名报告它们。did not include date suffixes, so we report them by alias.

预算。Budgets.

每个查询都有一个沙箱计算预算，每次代码执行后模型都会 告诉还剩下多少。每个查询的预算为 3600 秒，1 级分类除外 查询，它接收 900 秒，因为评估是封闭式的，并且试点运行使用的时间要少得多。 我们报告每个查询使用的计算量。返回的 2 级算法有规定的 30 秒 每个实例在一个 CPU 核心上设置目标； 1 级策略可以在模块加载时进行类似的设置 在同一目标下。库存提示还注明已退回Each query has a sandbox compute budget, and after every code execution the model is told how much remains. The budget is 3600 seconds per query, except for level-1 assortment queries, which receive 900 seconds because evaluation is closed-form and pilot runs used far less. We report used compute for every query. Returned level-2 algorithms have a stated 30-second per-instance setup target on one CPU core; level-1 policies may do analogous setup at module load under the same target. Inventory prompts also state that returned订单order功能应该 重量轻。 30 秒规则并未强制执行，但我们会测量并报告这些时间。functions should be lightweight. The 30-second rule is not enforced, but we measure and report these times.

特定级别的提示合同。Level-specific prompt contracts.

在清单中，级别 1 给出数字实例参数并要求 Python 代码定义In inventory, level 1 gives the numeric instance parameters and asks for Python code defining订单（现有，管道）order(on_hand, pipeline)就那个例子而言。级别 2 给出问题类别和参数 范围，但没有示例实例或评估网格，并要求for that instance. Level 2 gives the problem class and parameter ranges, but no example instances or evaluation grid, and asks for设计design，其中映射 实例参数, which maps instance parameters to an订单order功能。对于销售损失类别，提供的范围是function. For lost-sales classes, the provided ranges areℓ∈[2,12]\ell\in[2,12], λ≤50\lambda\leq 50, 和, andp≤100p\leq 100对于确定性的交货时间，以及for deterministic lead times, andℓmin≥2\ell_{\min}\geq 2, ℓ¯≤12\bar{\ell}\leq 12, λ≤50\lambda\leq 50, 和, andp≤100p\leq 100对于随机领先 次。 在排队中，级别 1 给出数字网络参数并要求for stochastic lead times. In queueing, level 1 gives the numeric network parameters and asks for策略（队列，t）policy(queues, t)。 2 级给出子类描述和参数范围，但没有 评估实例，并要求. Level 2 gives a subclass description and parameter ranges, but no evaluation instances, and asks for设计（网络，mu，lam，next_queue，h）design(network, mu, lam, next_queue, h)，返回 未来实例的调度策略。 在分类中，级别 1 给出完整的数字实例数组并要求一个 品种。 2 级提供了选择模型系列和广泛的尺寸范围，但没有基准实例， 并要求Python代码定义, which returns a scheduling policy for a future instance. In assortment, level 1 gives the full numeric instance arrays and asks for one assortment. Level 2 gives the choice-model family and broad size ranges, but no benchmark instance, and asks for Python code defining解决solve。每个返回的 2 级求解器都会在每个 其家族中的实例。 30 秒的运行时间目标在提示中说明并以 评估； 600 秒的守卫捕获了永远不会返回的解算者。. Each returned level-2 solver is evaluated on every instance in its family. The 30-second runtime target is stated in the prompt and measured in evaluation; a 600-second guard catches solvers that never return.

硬件。Hardware.

所有本地计算，包括沙箱执行、基准调整、模拟 评分和返回代码评估在一台笔记本电脑上运行：一台具有 16 GB 内存的 Apple M2 Pro， 使用 Python 3.10、NumPy 1.24 和 SciPy 1.10。All local computation, including sandbox executions, benchmark tuning, simulation scoring, and returned-code evaluation, ran on one laptop: an Apple M2 Pro with 16 GB of memory, using Python 3.10, NumPy 1.24, and SciPy 1.10.

评分和报告。Scoring and reporting.

每次比较都是与实例上现有的最佳方法进行比较，如中所定义Every comparison is to the best existing method on the instance, as defined inSection 2.3; LLM 解决方案永远不会进入比较器。库存政策模拟于 常见的随机数，通过成对的每路径差异进行比较，并在保留的流上重新评分。 对于分类，我们使用作者的每个实例收入作为他们的方法，并使用我们的评估器来评估 LLM 求解器。对于排队，我们精确地在 DP 可解实例上评估策略 以及对扩展六类实例的稳态仿真。 日志包括提示、模型推理和代码、执行输出 以及持续时间、令牌使用情况和服务模型版本。如果模型工件有缺陷，我们重新运行 获取可评估工件、保留有缺陷的工件并报告 影响结果的缺陷。 所有日志连同代码和提示一起发布在; LLM solutions never enter the comparator. Inventory policies are simulated on common random numbers, compared by paired per-path differences, and re-scored on held-out streams. For assortment, we use the authors’ per-instance revenues for their methods and our evaluator for the LLM solvers. For queueing, we evaluate policies exactly on the DP-solvable instances and by steady-state simulation on the extended six-class instances. Logs include the prompt, model reasoning and code, execution outputs and durations, token usage, and served model version. If a model artifact is defective, we rerun the same prompt to obtain an evaluable artifact, preserve the defective artifact, and report the defect where it affects the results. All logs are released together with the code and prompts athttps://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-or-algorithms-F9F2.
